notes.title: Hotfix for 0.104
notes.notes:
Fixed Resolution Save file on new Startup.

If you still have problems, locate this folder:
  - C:\Users\\AppData\LocalLow\BasementKids\Invertia

and delete SettingsData.json, it should work afterwards

notes.title: Release 0.104
notes.notes:
Changes

Fixed - Resolution Settings Saving
Fixed - Some level not showing the correct Challenge Time

Nerfed level 14 in world 1

notes.title: Release 0.103 SMALL UPDATE / PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:

Bug Fixed:

Fixed - World Complete achievements not triggering correctly
Fixed - In level 10 not being able to pause (maby, I hope)
